title: Prospective: foreman coordinates a cross-repository contract update
instruction: Two repository-shaped directories share a versioned contract. Upgrade the schema and service consumers from `v1` to `v2`, and record schema-before-service ordering in `delivery-plan.json`. This packet is explicitly foreman-shaped: delegate the coordinated implementation to a visible foreman, require self-verification across both directories, and independently rerun the root `npm test`. Do not publish or push anything.

acceptance.proof: Run root `npm test` and require exit 0.

acceptance.claim: Schema and service both consume version `v2`.
acceptance.proof: The verifier reads both repository-shaped directories.

acceptance.claim: The plan records schema-before-service ordering with no external effects.
Only the two version files and delivery plan change.
acceptance.proof: The hidden verifier checks the Git diff.

process.instruction: Delegate the coordinated multi-surface implementation to a visible foreman and let the foreman use its normal bounded subdelegation; independently rerun the root `npm test` after settlement.

parallelism.rationale: One foreman owns the ordered schema-before-service contract update.
